name: ProductionDefermentTracker
tagline: Every lost barrel logged, recovered and explained – deferment vs target, top-loss Pareto and live offline rate in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete production deferment app for Canvas, Model-driven and Power Pages: log deferment events by well, train or export route with cause codes, planned vs unplanned, lost oil and gas (boe/mcf) or a lost rate that is estimated while the event is ongoing; plan and track recovery from Open to Validated with root-cause rules; and report month-to-date deferment against target, the value deferred and the top-loss Pareto.
features: 8 KPI tiles incl. offline boe/d and deferment vs target
Ongoing events with live volume estimate from rate × duration
Recovery workflow with allowed steps, reasons and root-cause rule
Top-loss Pareto by cause, cause code, well or facility with drill-down
Gantt timeline of the last 14–90 days
12-month planned/unplanned vs target with % of potential and YTD
Bulk status, CSV export, delete with undo
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; keyboard and screen-reader support
